expectedUsable: Activating "Skip to main content" moves focus to the start of the main article, letting keyboard users bypass the masthead and section nav.

violations.expectedFix: Point the skip link at an existing target: change href to "#content" (or change the <main> id to "main-content") so the anchor resolves and focus moves into <main>.
violations.notes: The skip link targets #main-content but the <main> id is "content", so activation does nothing. axe's skip-link check is a best-practice rule (not a WCAG SC), so the WCAG-conformance scan is clean while 2.4.1 Bypass Blocks is effectively broken.
